specification.title: A nested scope fails, and PostgreSQL rejects its ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT
steps: Start the outer transaction with the framework's ordinary transaction API, on a pool of one connection.
Write the marker `outer`, and make sure the write was sent.
Start a nested scope with the framework's nested-transaction (savepoint) API, and write the marker `inner` in it.
Arm the client-side fault (the next ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT is rewritten to name a savepoint that does not exist, so PostgreSQL rejects it), then raise an application error in the nested scope.
The outer scope catches the nested scope's error, and ends normally.
Checkpoint `after-outer`, after the outer transaction's API has returned: report the same backend PID. The runner records whether that session is still inside a transaction.

invariants.statement: If the API reports that the outer transaction committed, PostgreSQL committed it, with the outer scope's writes and none of the failed nested scope's writes.
When the outer transaction's API has returned, the connection that ran it is no longer inside a transaction.

execution.description: TypeORM's defaults, with the managed transaction API ds.transaction(callback).

server.version: PostgreSQL 18.6 (Debian 18.6-1.pgdg13+2) on aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu, compiled by gcc (Debian 14.2.0-19) 14.2.0, 64-bit

fault.mechanism: A client-side injection in the adapter's driver layer: ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT is rewritten before it is sent, so that PostgreSQL rejects it with an error (3B001) that aborts the transaction. The error is PostgreSQL's; the trigger is artificial.
fault.injection_point: The framework's rollback of the nested scope.
fault.preconditions: The framework's statements pass through the instrumented pg module (recorded as trace_sees_framework_pg).
fault.expected_server: The transaction is aborted. A later COMMIT is answered with ROLLBACK.
fault.expected_client: A PostgreSQL error from the nested scope's rollback.

knowledge: The framework receives PostgreSQL's error for the savepoint rollback, and later, if it sends COMMIT, the command tag ROLLBACK.

api_outcome.basis: ds.transaction(callback) rejected with an error the callback did not throw
api_outcome.contract: In TypeORM 1.1.2, ds.transaction(callback) (EntityManager.transaction) starts a transaction, runs the callback, calls commitTransaction() and returns the callback's result; if the callback throws, it calls rollbackTransaction(), ignores any rollback error, and rethrows (entity-manager/EntityManager.js). A resolved call is TypeORM's report that the transaction committed.

error.message: current transaction is aborted, commands ignored until end of transaction block
application error: the nested scope fails

evaluation.reason: TX-02.2 violated: the session after the outer API returned: "idle in transaction"

preconditions.description: the nested scope's error reached the outer scope, which handled it
the runner observed the transaction's session after the outer API returned

invariants.statement: If the API reports that the outer transaction committed, PostgreSQL committed it, with the outer scope's writes and none of the failed nested scope's writes.
invariants.detail: the API reported: failed; pg_xact_status: aborted; outer visible: false; inner (failed scope) visible: false

invariants.statement: When the outer transaction's API has returned, the connection that ran it is no longer inside a transaction.
invariants.detail: the session after the outer API returned: "idle in transaction"

invariants: TX-02.2: When the outer transaction's API has returned, the connection that ran it is no longer inside a transaction.
contract_basis.framework: In TypeORM 1.1.2, ds.transaction(callback) (EntityManager.transaction) starts a transaction, runs the callback, calls commitTransaction() and returns the callback's result; if the callback throws, it calls rollbackTransaction(), ignores any rollback error, and rethrows (entity-manager/EntityManager.js). A resolved call is TypeORM's report that the transaction committed.

reproduction.requires: pnpm run setup, then pnpm run pg:up (README.md)
